content: seeds-a77c HITL pilot: human gates live in the CONDUCTOR parent only (develop children run args.auto_approve=true and would self-answer gates with the first option). Gate node DSL in workflow.fabro: shape=hexagon, human.question, human.options ('skip:[S] ... | park:[P] ...'), human.freeform, human.default_choice, timeout_seconds; gate outcome edges condition on human.choice/human.freeform and must be kind=soft (FAIL-CLOSED: pending gate blocks the run, timeout default skip self-heals). Routing-label contract: every new preferred_next_label needs BOTH the node's outgoing edge (preferred_label condition) AND the output-schema enum — structural check compares enum vs preferred_label-conditioned edges (unconditional default edges like 'Seed claimed' and 'Unrouted ...' safety nets are outside the enum contract). Node-attr regex checks must not use [^]]* when human.options contains literal [S]/[P].
